description: This file defines classes, traits, and objects related to serializing and parsing Metric View configurations in Spark SQL, including exception handling, source types, column metadata, and the main MetricView class.

classes.name: MetricView
classes.description: Represents a metric view configuration including version, source, optional filter, and selected columns.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: Sealed trait for different source types in a metric view, with implementations for asset and SQL sources.

classes.name: AssetSource
classes.description: Represents a catalog asset source such as a table or view.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Defines a column in the metric view, including its name, expression, and type.

classes.name: ColumnMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for a column, including type and expression, with JSON annotations.

classes.name: Expression
classes.description: Sealed trait for different expression types used in columns.

classes.name: ColumnType
classes.description: Enumeration for column types: dimension or measure.

classes.name: YAMLVersion
classes.description: Represents the version info parsed from YAML.

classes.name: MetricViewSerdeException
classes.description: Base exception class for serialization/deserialization errors.

classes.name: MetricViewValidationException
classes.description: Exception for validation errors in metric view parsing.

classes.name: MetricViewFromProtoException
classes.description: Exception for errors converting from proto representations.

methods.name: SourceType.fromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a SourceType enum value, case-insensitive.

methods.name: Source.apply
methods.description: Creates a Source object by parsing the input string as either a table identifier or a query.

methods.name: Column.columnType
methods.description: Determines the column type (dimension or measure) based on the expression.

methods.name: Column.getColumnMetadata
methods.description: Generates column metadata, validating expression size.

methods.name: ColumnType.fromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a ColumnType enum value, case-insensitive.
